task_description: Build an Instagram auto-ping feature that monitors an Instagram account for new posts/reels via the Instagram Graph API and sends WhatsApp notifications with post link, caption, and like reminder. Includes !ig commands for status/control, state persistence in data/igState.json, and token expiry warnings.

verification.summary: All syntax checks pass (node --check on index.js, commandHandler.js, instagramMonitor.js). Docker image builds successfully. No test framework exists in this project so validation is syntax + Docker build.
